title: Budget adjustment
passage: Did the committee increase the marketing budget? A. The market closes at six. B. Only for the online campaign. C. A committee of five members.
passageZh:
委員會有增加行銷預算嗎？
A. 市場六點關閉。
B. 只有網路行銷活動的預算增加。
C. 由五人組成的委員會。
